title: TickPulse Runtime & DB
description: .NET runtime (CPU, memory, GC, thread pool) and PostgreSQL client health (Npgsql pool and query durations).

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Process CPU time as a share of all available cores.

panels.title: Working set
panels.description: Physical memory used by the process.

panels.title: GC heap
panels.description: Managed heap size after the last collection.

panels.title: Thread pool threads
panels.description: Worker threads currently in the .NET thread pool.

panels.title: Exceptions / s
panels.description: Exceptions thrown per second (handled or not).

panels.title: DB connections
panels.description: Npgsql pool connections currently in use.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: Process CPU by mode as a share of all cores.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Working set vs. GC-committed memory vs. live managed heap.

panels.title: Collections by generation
panels.description: Garbage collections per second.

panels.title: Heap by generation
panels.description: Managed heap size per generation after the last collection.

panels.title: Allocation rate
panels.description: Bytes allocated on the managed heap per second.

panels.title: GC pause time
panels.description: Share of wall-clock time spent in GC pauses.

panels.title: Thread pool
panels.description: Thread pool threads and queued work items (right axis).

panels.title: Work items
panels.description: Thread pool work items completed per second.

panels.title: Lock contention & exceptions
panels.description: Monitor lock contentions and exceptions per second, by exception type.

panels.title: Connection pool
panels.description: Npgsql pool connections by state; the dashed line is the pool maximum.

panels.title: Query duration
panels.description: Database operation duration, p50 / p95 / p99.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="tickpulse-api"}[$__rate_interval]))) or histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(db_client_commands_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="tickpulse-api"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="tickpulse-api"}[$__rate_interval]))) or histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(db_client_commands_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="tickpulse-api"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="tickpulse-api"}[$__rate_interval]))) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(db_client_commands_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="tickpulse-api"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Database operations
panels.description: Operations per second, failed operations and pool-acquire timeouts.

panels.title: Accepted by the collector
panels.description: Spans, metric points and log records the OTel Collector accepted per second.

panels.title: Export failures
panels.description: Telemetry the collector could not deliver to Tempo, Prometheus or Loki, or refused under memory pressure.

panels.title: Collector memory
panels.description: Resident memory of the OTel Collector (container limit 128 MiB).
